scene: Atop the tall ladder, a high balcony overlooks three nocturnal departures.
picture: Side-scrolling view of an open-air transit balcony. At the far left, a ladder top hooks to the railing, beside a glowing ferris wheel gondola. The tall Latino player stands on the platform facing right. In the centre idle a purple night bus, and on the far right waits a yellow bicycle rickshaw.
shown: a swinging neon ferris wheel gondola parked at the edge on the left
a sleek purple night bus idling beside a signpost in the centre
a yellow bicycle rickshaw with a friendly driver waiting on the far right
